outcome: Give hospital coo / chief medical information officer a governed method to improve avoidable OR idle hours using case durations, surgeon rosters and sterile processing logs, with final decisions…
overview: Operating Room Scheduling and Turnover Analytics addresses operational records arrive through different systems, supervisors reconstruct evidence manually, and decisions are difficult to audit in healthcare providers operations. The first proof of value uses case durations, surgeon rosters and sterile processing logs. It produces a reviewed operational recommendation and a traceable decision record. The commercial success measure is avoidable OR idle hours, established from customer baseline data before any improvement is claimed.

scope:
Delivery model: Redington or approved implementation partner, eligibility and staffing pending confirmation.
Duration: Discovery and design first; pilot and rollout durations depend on data access and scope; no fixed commitment.
1) Discover source quality and baseline: case durations, surgeon rosters and sterile processing logs; define avoidable OR idle hours and data-processing boundary.
2) Design control points, security and connector contracts; obtain owner approval from Hospital COO / Chief Medical Information Officer.
3) Implement one bounded workflow, instrument missing-data exceptions and system-of-record write-back.
4) Test positive, negative, privilege, partial-data and rollback cases including line-by-line reconciliations against known business transactions.
5) Review KPI in the pilot, document evidence, perform training and agree transition.
